claim: The web hosting whitepaper, which is marked as a historical reference, describes multiple Auto Scaling groups for different layers of the architecture, so each layer can scale independently, for example on network I/O for web servers and CPU utilization for application servers.

evidence.quote: As shown in the AWS web hosting architecture model, you can create multiple Auto Scaling groups for different layers of the architecture, so that each layer can scale independently.
evidence.title: Automatically scaling the fleet

evidence.quote: For example, the web server Auto Scaling group might trigger scaling in and out in response to changes in network I/O, whereas the application server Auto Scaling group might scale out and in according to CPU utilization.
